Unknown command: stdio

tdqs — Tool Definition Quality Score

Usage
  tdqs lint  [input] [--server-name <name>] [--format json|markdown|text] [--fail-on error|warning|never] [--output <path>]
  tdqs score [input] [--model <id>] [--base-url <url>] [--api-key <key>] [--concurrency <n>]
             [--request-overrides <json>] [--format json|markdown|text] [--fail-under A|B|C|D]
             [--output <path>] [--hosted <site url>]
  tdqs --version
  tdqs --help

Input (exactly one)
  --file <path>        A JSON file: a tools/list result ({ "tools": [...] }), an array of tools, or one tool.
                       "-" reads standard input.
  --command "<cmd>"    Spawn a stdio MCP server and read its tools/list.
  --url <url>          Connect to a Streamable HTTP MCP server. Repeat --header "Name: value" for auth.

lint    The deterministic stages only: context signals, hard gates, the shadow prefilter and the
        checklist the specification ranks highest. Needs no model and no key.
score   The full pipeline: every tool through the rubric, then coherence, then the server rollup.
        Needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (--base-url, --api-key, --model, or the TDQS_BASE_URL,
        TDQS_API_KEY and TDQS_MODEL environment variables), or --hosted to score through a TDQS site
        with that site's API key as --api-key or TDQS_API_KEY.
        --request-overrides (or TDQS_REQUEST_OVERRIDES) merges provider-specific JSON into every
        request; turn extended reasoning off with it, e.g. '{"reasoning":{"enabled":false}}' on
        OpenRouter — the calibration examples reproduce with reasoning off, at seconds per call.

Exit codes
  0  done
  1  the threshold was not met (--fail-on for lint, --fail-under for score)
  2  usage error, unreadable input, unreachable server, or a model failure
